description: During the 2026-07-30 boot sequence, Master again did not spawn Knox for plaud-ingest. Justification given at the time was 'no explicit request' plus prior sessions showing token friction on unattended Plaud pulls. David corrected this: plaud-ingest is a standing Phase 0 requirement in the boot workflow, not a judgment call Master gets to make session to session, and this is at least the second boot in a row it was skipped.
correction: Knox should be spawned live for plaud-ingest on every boot per the Data Sources Required table in workflows/boot/workflow.md, regardless of Master's own risk assessment about prior token friction. If Knox hits a real blocker (missing token, no new recordings), that's Knox's finding to report, not Master's assumption to make in advance.
systemic_fix: Treat the plaud-ingest spawn in boot Phase 0 as unconditional. Master's role is to fire the spawn and let Knox report status, not to pre-judge whether the spawn is worth attempting based on past outcomes.
